steps.question: What separates groups on the page?
steps.why: Space separates groups; lines would interrupt reading.
Space alone separates sections; lines add noise.

steps.rule: Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.
steps.pick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.33:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.
steps.darkPick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.76:1, on surface.default). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.

steps.why: Rounded corners match the warm reading tone. Sharp corners feel technical next to long text.

steps.question: What contrast floor do we hold?
steps.why: AA contrast, with large text helping further.
Keyboard users must always see where they are.

steps.pick: navy.light.600: the focus ring, so the keyboard's place is never lost, 11.5:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: navy.dark.600: the focus ring, so the keyboard's place is never lost, 6.86:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.

steps.pick: neutral.50, under content: 1.02:1 from surface.default, so cards and panels stand forward.
steps.darkPick: neutral.0, under content: 1.1:1 from surface.default, so cards and panels stand forward.
